content: AbortSignal.timeout(ms) is a static method (Node 17.3+, stable in Node 18 LTS) that returns an AbortSignal which auto-aborts after ms milliseconds with a TimeoutError DOMException (name 'TimeoutError' in modern Node; some runtimes surface 'AbortError'). Pass it as the fetch() 'signal' option; catch by checking err.name. Node 22 (this project's engine) fully supports it.
